# telnyx_phone_number_job (Data Source)

A background job that releases or updates phone numbers in bulk, with its status and the numbers that succeeded or failed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The status of a bulk update or release job, and the numbers that failed.
data "telnyx_phone_number_job" "update" {
  id = "42587e44-3a3e-46de-9255-0c9a7a1d1ec7"
}

output "failed_numbers" {
  value = data.telnyx_phone_number_job.update.failed_operations[*].phone_number
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `etc` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the estimated time of completion of the background job.
- `failed_operations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--failed_operations))
- `parameters` (Attributes) Effective parameters saved when the job was created, not a snapshot of the original HTTP request or current phone-number settings. Update jobs include the saved update fields; emergency-settings jobs include the saved emergency fields; delete jobs include only targets. Absent fields are omitted, and saved false, null and empty values are preserved. Tags may be normalized to arrays; filter-created jobs contain resolved target identifiers rather than the original filters. Historical jobs with no saved arguments return an empty object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))
- `pending_operations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pending_operations))
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers))
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) Indicates the completion status of the background update.
- `successful_operations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--successful_operations))
- `type` (String) Identifies the type of the background job.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
